description: After paying a quote, verify the Solana transaction on-chain (correct recipient, amount worth at least 95% of the price, carries the quote reference, confirmed, under 7 days old) and receive a RugRadar Pro API key valid for 30 days per payment. Idempotent: the same signature with the same order returns the same key; a signature can only be redeemed once.

signature.description: Solana transaction signature of the payment

name: verify_payment_and_get_key
title: Verify payment, get a Pro key
